name: The Delivery Guy
summary:
A short psx styled horror game by Unfall Games

You are a broke guy that would take any job to pay his cat's food (and rent).

One day you read about a pizza place that is searching their new delivery guy, the owner of the place has reported that he had to hire 3 delivery guys in the last month only, and that they have never returned. So you decide to send your rèsumé to that place without expecting anything, but during a boring evening...

The place is known for having some strange customers and workers, also, it's the only place in town that makes deliveries at night, but you decide to take the job, the pay seems good and you really need that.

You tell yourself that there is nothing to worry and that nothing will happen to you, but unfortunately... You couldn't have been more wrong...
